doc.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025

title: Closing and goodbyes
summary: Varner offers links to his Bandcamp miniatures and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: We could go on and on, couldn’t we?

I’m happy to send you more. I could send you pages and pages of more, or links if you’d like. I’ll send you some of the links, the Band Camp, the more recent, the miniatures, basically those records from the trip. Yes.
Excellent. I’d enjoy that. Thank you.
Thank you for doing what you do. I really appreciate it.
I’ll just stop this and we’ll say our good-byes.
